newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Six killed in Nigerian communal clash, paper says.
newsitem.headline: Six killed in Nigerian communal clash, paper says.

text.p: Six people were killed and several others wounded in a land dispute between two communities in Nigeria's southeastern Akwa Ibom state, the independent Guardian newspaper reported on Saturday.
Guns and machetes were freely used in the fighting between the communities in Ibiono on December 24 and 15 houses were also set ablaze, said a local council official.
Communal clashes over rival claims to farmlands are common in rural areas of Nigeria.
The council official said riot police were patrolling Ibiono and calm had been restored in the area.
